description: This PHP script enables exporting requirements data in various formats (CSV, XML) within the TestLink test management platform. It handles initialization, user permissions, and the export process, dynamically generating the export content based on user-selected scope and format.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing the requirements export page, enforcing rights 'mgt_view_req'.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments, setting default values as needed.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI configuration data based on request arguments and requirements specifications.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the data export in the selected format (CSV or XML), constructs content, and triggers download.
